# VerticalLinePath { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.VerticalLinePath }

```python
loader.graphical.VerticalLinePath(x, y0, y1, tolerance=10.0)
```

Time axis as a vertical line at fixed x.

Useful for vertical timelines where y maps to time.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| x         | [Number](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.Number`) | Fixed x coordinate.                                                                                                                                              |
| y0        | [Number](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.Number`) | Starting y coordinate (top).                                                                                                                                     |
| y1        | [Number](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.Number`) | Ending y coordinate (bottom).                                                                                                                                    |
| tolerance | [Number](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.Number`) | The half-breadth of the strip the line stands for: the strip spans ``x - tolerance`` to ``x + tolerance``, and :meth:`from_2d` answers for the points within it. |

Every number is kept as given: integers (and ``Fraction`` values) give
exact answers.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [distance_to_path](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.VerticalLinePath.distance_to_path) | Distance calculation for vertical line. |
| [from_2d](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.VerticalLinePath.from_2d) | Map (x, y) to timeline coordinate (None outside the strip or the line). |
| [to_2d](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.VerticalLinePath.to_2d) | Map timeline coordinate to (x, y). |
